name: Free tier features locked behind Premium
summary: Free users report being unable to replay, seek, select, or queue songs, skip freely, or view lyrics without paying for Premium.

name: Generic dislike without specific defect
summary: Customers simply call the app bad, worst, garbage, or something to uninstall or ban, without naming any concrete problem.

name: Too many, repetitive and annoying ads
summary: Customers complain of excessive ad frequency, back-to-back ads between songs, blank ads, and ads that are irritating and disruptive.

name: Songs won't play, skip, pause or cut out
summary: Customers report tracks refusing to start, wrong songs playing, playback freezing or pausing, and songs cutting out or skipping repeatedly.

name: Generic complaints that the latest update is bad
summary: Customers broadly say the new or latest update is worse than before and urge uninstalling, without naming a specific feature that broke.

name: Shuffle, queue, and playlist playback going wrong
summary: Customers report that shuffle, skip, and playlist ordering behave unpredictably, that clicked songs play different tracks, and that unwanted songs get inserted into playlists and liked songs.

name: Unable to log in to existing account
summary: Customers repeatedly get login errors, 'something went wrong', or phone-number rejections that prevent them from getting back into accounts they already have.

name: Frequent crashes, freezes, and installation failures
summary: Customers report the app freezing or crashing during playback or navigation, songs failing to play, and the app failing to install or open.

name: Disliked redesign hurts navigation and home screen
summary: Customers report that the new UI and home dashboard are cluttered, ugly, and hard to navigate, with features moved or removed and content they don't want forced on them.

name: Songs and artists removed or unavailable
summary: Users say favorite songs, artists, and playlists are missing, greyed out, or removed from the catalog, sometimes only playing previews.

name: Playback controls and toggles behaving badly
summary: Customers report that repeat, skip-back/forward, toggles and autoplay controls are unreliable or missing, and that the app keeps resuming playback or prompting them against their wishes.

name: Premium pricing seen as too expensive
summary: Customers say Premium costs too much, keeps rising, and that the app feels greedy about money and ads.

name: Playback settings and app-update regressions
summary: Customers report miscellaneous playback breakage such as wrong songs playing, equaliser resets, empty playlists, and background play failing after app updates.

name: Lyrics fail to load or are missing
summary: Customers report lyrics not appearing or loading for many songs, including popular artists, after recent updates.

name: False offline errors despite active connection
summary: Customers see 'no internet' or offline messages even while connected via WiFi or mobile data, and sometimes music fails to play on mobile data.

name: Political, religious, and boycott objections
summary: Customers express boycotts or uninstalls over the company's country of origin, religious objections to music, or perceived political agendas.

name: Premium purchase or benefits not applying
summary: Subscribers report paying for Premium but not receiving it, losing benefits over time, or being unable to purchase or reactivate a plan.

name: Irrelevant recommendations and shuffle behavior
summary: Customers feel the recommendation algorithm, mixes, and shuffle serve songs outside their taste or playlist, often switching genre unexpectedly and repeating the same order.

name: Breaks with Bluetooth, car, and smart speaker devices
summary: Customers report playback failing or desyncing through Bluetooth, Android Auto, car systems, Alexa, Google Home, and PlayStation, plus unwanted auto-start.

name: Slow loading, lag, battery and data drain
summary: Customers say the app is slow to start and load, lags during playback, drains battery quickly, and uses excessive mobile data.

name: Downloaded music fails to play offline
summary: Customers report that downloaded songs and playlists stop working without internet, with offline mode redirecting to a blank app, playback vanishing, or only a few tracks playing.

name: Search returns wrong or unrelated songs
summary: Customers report that searching for a specific song yields a different track than the one selected, that search is slow, and that some playlists or songs are hard to find.

name: Accounts reset, hacked, or losing saved data
summary: Customers report being logged out or hacked, premium status reverting to free, and liked songs, playlists, or history disappearing after switching devices or numbers.

name: Downloads stall, fail, or are slow
summary: Customers report downloads that never start, take hours, fail on mobile or SD card storage, or cannot be done for individual songs without downloading a whole album or playlist.

name: Downloaded music disappears and must be re-downloaded
summary: Customers say offline songs and playlists get deleted after updates, restarts, or over days, forcing them to download the music again.

name: Poor sound quality and missing audio features
summary: Customers report low volume, distorted or scratchy sound, audio dropping out, sound only in one ear, and requests for lossless, HiFi, or Dolby Atmos audio.

name: Unauthorized or duplicate subscription charges
summary: Users say their cards or accounts were charged for Premium they never ordered, charged repeatedly, or charged after cancelling, with no easy way to stop it.

name: Payment methods declined or failing at checkout
summary: Customers report cards, mobile-load, and carrier payment options being declined, errors during purchase, and no retry option when paying for premium plans.

name: Miscellaneous unrelated feedback
summary: Customers mention assorted topics such as missing Wrapped or following lists, device issues, comparisons to YouTube Music, hidden songs reappearing, and privacy concerns about third-party access.

name: Miscellaneous bugs, autoplay, and missing features
summary: Customers report a mix of issues including unwanted autoplay that restarts after ads, a missing app icon, sharing failures, missing played history, and Chromebook problems.

name: Miscellaneous catalog and playback problems
summary: Customers report a mix of unrelated catalog issues, including wrong artist pages opening, unwanted content such as news shows or local files appearing, language mismatches, and playback that stops working.

name: Miscellaneous access, install, and library problems
summary: Customers report assorted access issues such as liked songs not opening, playlists not working, app failing to install or launch, and difficulty switching accounts or countries.

name: Sign-up and verification codes failing
summary: Customers cannot create accounts because verification codes never arrive, phone numbers or emails are rejected, or sign-up shows generic errors or offline messages.

name: Unclear, off-topic, or uninterpretable reviews
summary: Reviews that are nonsensical, unrelated to the app, or written in unclear or non-English text, with no actionable complaint about the product.

name: Podcast and audiobook playback and availability
summary: Customers say podcasts and audiobooks disappear from their library, cannot be played, lack full episode access or proper notifications, and are shown with unwanted ads.

name: General premium pricing and paywall complaints
summary: Customers complain that Spotify is money-focused, pushes premium and forced ads while paying, and that purchases such as songs or audiobooks fail to work.

name: Support unreachable, slow or unhelpful
summary: Customers say support is hard to reach, only offers bots, takes hours to respond, ignores complaints, and gives poor service.

name: Missing or limited download options
summary: Customers say they cannot download songs or save music locally, lack SD card storage, or cannot easily find and select their downloaded albums and podcasts.

name: General praise or neutral remarks
summary: Customers give mild or general approval, neutral comments, or feature feedback without describing a specific defect, such as calling the app okay or nice with room for improvement.

name: Miscellaneous support complaints and account issues
summary: Customers raise mixed support concerns including unwanted emails, share feature timeouts, address verification errors, and update-related reinstall needs.
